name: cadence-300-blocks
spec: op-private-interop/docs/DESIGN.md: the claim is an ordinary L2 transaction, and it leads the range it describes.
description: The operating point: one 10-minute cadence at 2 s block time, 300 public blocks, mid-chain. Note it is the same 352 bytes as every other empty-proof claim — v1 carries no per-block data, so claim size is independent of range size.
